title: LiveProtocol
description: Messages on the player web UI's websocket, /ws/, and the HTTP API's responses, /api/.

Act.description:
An action (`league.web.live.actions`): `name` is one of `ActionName`, and `args` that
action's arguments, as `ActionArgs` lists them. The ack carries the same `id`.
Act.title: Act

ApiError.description:
Any refusal that isn't a sentence. `not-set-up`: the web's server has no league or no
open season yet.
ApiError.title: ApiError

Award.description:
One of the six postgame awards. `stats` holds the numbers its line quotes:
mvp: kills, souls, damage. wrecking_ball: objective_damage. first_blood: t, victim.
the_wall: taken, mitigated. field_medic: healing. dead_eye: accuracy, crit_rate.
Award.title: Award

Beat.description: A story beat for the Summary's soul-lead line.
Beat.title: Beat

CaptainStatus.description: Whether they can be a captain now, under the mode's rule.
CaptainStatus.title: CaptainStatus

ChatView.description: The one chat the viewer can see now.
ChatView.title: ChatView

DamageTo.description: Hero damage to one enemy. A player's list adds up to their `damage`.
DamageTo.title: DamageTo

Event.description:
The timeline's list, in time order. `ref` indexes `fights`, `objectives` or `mid_boss`
by `type`; it's 0 for first blood.
Event.title: Event

HttpApi.description:
Each endpoint's response body, for the generated types. Never sent itself.
`/api/session/` is `league.web.auth.views.session_view`'s own, and the share card is a PNG.
HttpApi.title: HttpApi

LadderRow.description: One line of the table. No player ID: profiles are private, so there's nothing to open.
LadderRow.title: LadderRow

MatchDetail.description: A match's public record. The same for every signed-in viewer.
MatchDetail.title: MatchDetail

MyProfile.description: The signed-in player's own profile. Nobody else's is ever sent.
MyProfile.title: MyProfile

Offer.description: A spot in someone else's match, offered to this player.
Offer.title: Offer

OfferEnd.description: The player's most recent offer that has ended, so the page can say how.
OfferEnd.title: OfferEnd

Purchase.description: An item bought, by deadlock-api's item ID, and when it was sold, if it was.
Purchase.title: Purchase

QueuePlace.description: The player's own place on the priority list. Nobody else's is ever sent.
QueuePlace.title: QueuePlace

RandomDraft.description: Every ban and pick in the mode's order, chosen at random. Nothing is recorded.
RandomDraft.title: RandomDraft

Refusal.description: The request wasn't taken. A plain sentence for the player, as the Discord bot says it.
Refusal.title: Refusal

ResultResponse.description: One captain's answer: a report, or a confirm or dispute of the other captain's.
ResultResponse.title: ResultResponse

Scoreboard.description:
Names on the latest scoreboard read that nobody has matched to a player yet. Only ever
sent to the match's captains, who can match them.
Scoreboard.title: Scoreboard

SearchPlayer.description: Someone to name as a sub. No stats: profiles are private.
SearchPlayer.title: SearchPlayer

SoulSources.description: Where a player's souls came from. Orbs count with what dropped them.
SoulSources.title: SoulSources

SteamLink.description: One of the player's own Steam accounts. Only ever sent to that player.
SteamLink.title: SteamLink

SteamRow.description:
One of the viewer's own Steam accounts. `id` is the link's own handle, for unlinking;
never the Steam ID.
SteamRow.title: SteamRow

StrikeEntry.description: An offence that gave strikes, or a staff adjustment. Clean matches aren't listed.
StrikeEntry.title: StrikeEntry

Structure.description:
Every structure, standing or not, for the replay's map. Positions are the web's: the
metadata doesn't place them.
Structure.title: Structure

SubDone.description: A sub request that has ended.
SubDone.title: SubDone

SubOutOptions.description: `subs.options`: who this player may ask to sub out, and what it would cost them.
SubOutOptions.title: SubOutOptions

SwapOffer.description: A captain's offer of one of their players for one of the other team's.
SwapOffer.title: SwapOffer

Timeline.description:
Leads at each minute, and at the end. `souls` is interpolated between the game's stat
snapshots (every few minutes); `kills` is exact.
Timeline.title: Timeline

Viewer.description: What the page needs to know about whoever is looking.
Viewer.title: Viewer

Wish.description: A hero one of the viewer's team (or the viewer) wants to play.
Wish.title: Wish

YourNight.description: The viewer's own part in the match. Only for a player on its roster.
YourNight.title: YourNight
